about: Per-model head trim floors (tools/model_face_overrides.head_floor, docs/MODEL_REDUCTION.md): a body whose locked seams fit inside today's total only when its head gives faces below the default floor of 120. Listed only from a measured bake with 0 uncovered openings and every limb at 0.5 or more; the bake's seam stop judges every bake that reads an entry. No faces are added.

entries.reason: With the head held at 120 faces the locked seams do not fit inside today's total; with the head down to 90 faces they do, with no added faces (NPC-BODY-REGRESSION-62).
